rollups.text: Salsa dancing timeline: By 2022-11-06, the user had attended Saturday salsa classes for about two months, reported soreness afterward and increased energy, and sought workouts and ways to maintain energy between classes. Around late December 2022, the user began Tuesday-evening classes; by 2023-02-02, after about six weeks, the user was attending regularly, improving footwork, and appreciating Latin music. The user credited instructor Maria’s clear explanations with helping them feel comfortable as a first-time dance-class attendee. The user attended a downtown salsa social on 2023-01-28..2023-01-29 and was considering a bachata festival for March 2023; attendance was not confirmed. The change from Saturday to Tuesday classes is reported but not explained.

Dance-learning and practice resources: The user practiced yoga at home with YouTube videos about 2–3 times a week (2022-11-02) and sought to improve flexibility and balance, including through Yin Yoga. The user watched salsa and bachata videos on YouTube to improve technique (2023-02-02), especially Salsa With Silvia for clear step breakdowns and production quality, and Edie, The Salsa FREAK, for energy and enthusiasm. The user practiced basic dance moves in front of a mirror, with cat Luna watching (2023-02-02).

Photography learning and interests: On 2022-10-27, the user said they had purchased a photography course and wanted additional online courses or tutorials. The user used commute time for educational material and was excited to explore photography resources. Later, the user expressed interest in street photography, enjoyed an inspiring “Street Photography” exhibition at an unnamed Photography Museum, and planned more museum visits and photography events (reported 2023-01-17). The user said they spent about two hours at the exhibition on March 14, but the year and timing are unclear and conflict with the 2023-01-17 conversation date.

Northwestern research exploration: On 2022-11-03, the user asked about undergraduate research opportunities at Northwestern University, how to find them, and how competitive they were. The user planned to explore opportunities and contact faculty in their department, and asked how to write an email that would stand out. The user's connection to Northwestern was not specified.

Melbourne study and banking plans: Before 2022-11-15, the user had been accepted to the University of Melbourne’s Master’s program in International Relations and was preparing to move to Melbourne. By 2022-11-15, enrollment was confirmed and an Australian student visa application had been submitted. The user encountered difficulty applying for an Australian bank account online because they lacked a Melbourne lease and utility bill, then decided to wait until arriving and open the account in person. The user also planned to learn about Australian mobile-payment options before arrival.

Dinner-party menu: On 2022-11-17, the user initially considered a seafood theme inspired by a positive dinner at The Wharf during an October 2022 beach-house stay, then decided to focus on food inspired by Stephanie Izard, especially Girl & the Goat, where the user had enjoyed dinner on the last night of a Chicago visit. The user wanted wood-fired flavors and spices and planned to serve wood-fired pepper and eggplant relish with fresh oregano, parsley, and lemon alongside the main course. Suggested side dishes were not confirmed as chosen.

Miami and South Florida travel planning: On 2022-11-17, the user planned a summer 2023 Miami trip, preferred a nonstop economy flight from Boston, had 10,000 Delta SkyMiles, and intended to check award availability. The user later reported earning 10,000 SkyMiles on a Boston–Atlanta round trip on 2023-01-15, had been approved for a Citi AAdvantage Executive card, and was weighing airline-mile diversification. On 2023-02-14, the user chose a JetBlue nonstop BOS–FLL flight and wanted a Delta return with a possible SkyMiles upgrade; no travel dates were specified. The assistant claimed to book both flights, but the conversation supplies no dates. The user asked for recurring reminders to check upgrade availability, but no schedule was established. On 2023-02-20, the user was also considering a week-long Miami trip with American Airlines, remained unsure after a poor entertainment experience, and expected to check one bag. The records do not establish whether these plans concern the same trip.

Paris trip planning: By February 2023, the user was planning a Paris trip for March 2023 and had purchased Allianz Travel insurance documents on 2023-01-25 for $150. The user considered visiting the Palace of Versailles and asked about the Paris Museum Pass and March weather. The user planned to ask Allianz whether cancellations or interruptions caused by unforeseen circumstances were covered and what claims required; no answer or trip outcome is recorded.

Tokyo and Yokohama travel: In January 2023, the user took a five-day solo trip to Tokyo and described it as amazing, staying in an inexpensive, tiny Shinjuku hostel room and finding some areas crowded and noisy. On 2023-02-21, while planning a trip to Asia, the user considered Tokyo for a family trip but worried it might overwhelm children and sought a quieter stay. The user considered Yokohama, especially Minato Mirai 21, asked about access to Yokohama Station and Yokohama Chinatown, and asked about halal and vegetarian food options. A family trip or booking was not confirmed.

Loyalty-points spreadsheet: On 2022-12-17, the user planned a spreadsheet for loyalty-program points, including “Program Since” and “Reward Threshold” columns and conditional formatting for balances near a threshold. The user planned an “Email Confirmations” sheet recording purchase date, program, transaction ID, points earned, confirmation email, and balance-update date, plus a “Reward Goal” field. The user had been a member of The Daily Grind for months and was close to earning a free drink. After purchasing there on 2022-12-14, the user confirmed on 2022-12-17 that the points had arrived and planned to update the spreadsheet.

Toyota Corolla maintenance and Bluetooth issue: The user owns or drives a 2018 Toyota Corolla and uses an iPhone 13. Bluetooth connectivity had been intermittent for weeks by 2023-02-28, with poor audio when connected. The user restarted the iPhone, reset the infotainment system, tried basic troubleshooting, and confirmed the software was current without resolving the problem; the user planned another dealership check during 2023-03-06..2023-03-12. On 2023-02-25, the user had an oil change after putting it off for a month; the car had about 23,000 miles and needed synthetic oil. The dealership quoted $120 and gave a $20 loyalty discount, and rotated the front tires after noticing uneven wear. The user also planned to wash and wax the car during 2023-03-04..2023-03-05 and considered professional detailing, intending to ask about discounts.

Snake plant Slinky: The user got Slinky on 2023-02-11 and reported on 2023-02-15 that she was doing well. The user considered slow-release fertilizer to reduce how often fertilizing needed to be remembered, but had not decided to switch. The user planned to buy soil and fertilizer and repot Slinky into fresh soil in a pot about two inches wider than her current one, with drainage holes; completion was not reported.

Startup social-media strategy: On 2023-01-18, the user wanted to improve the startup’s social-media presence, especially Instagram engagement, and track effectiveness using analytics. The user said they would consider suggested content strategies and analytics tools, and try more engaging Instagram ideas. The user was also considering a social-media contest to increase engagement and attract followers and asked about partnering with niche influencers and measuring results. No implementation or campaign outcome was reported.

Reading and movie tracking: On 2023-02-08, the user had started reading The Song of Achilles by Madeline Miller for a book club, was interested in All the Light We Cannot See by Anthony Doerr, and wanted to increase reading speed. The user said commute audiobooks had increased reading speed and that they used an unspecified app to track reading. The user was interested in Goodreads. On 2023-02-16, after watching a South Korean film and wanting lighter international films and romantic comedies, the user planned to start Amélie and decided to organize a movie watchlist in Google Sheets, with date-added and streaming-platform columns. The user said they would begin adding films; no completed list is reported.

rollups.text: The user reported poor American Airlines in-flight entertainment on at least two occasions: an undated New York–Los Angeles flight for which a flight attendant offered a free-drink voucher (later described as occurring on 2023-02-20), and a separate 2023-02-20 report of a New York–Los Angeles flight that day with the same kind of complaint and voucher offer. The records may describe the same incident rather than two distinct flights, so the number of separate incidents is uncertain. The user remained concerned about flying American Airlines but was willing to consider giving it another chance.

The user reported attending salsa classes on two different schedules over time: Saturday classes for about two months by 2022-11-06, and Tuesday-evening classes begun around late December 2022, attended regularly by 2023-02-02. The records do not establish whether the schedule changed or whether these were separate classes.
